retrieval_policy.chunking: One atomic, independently citable fact per chunk; headings are retained as metadata and no chunk crosses a section boundary.
retrieval_policy.verification: Only the committed chunks below may support a claim. Missing evidence is reported as unsupported.

chunks.title: Location
chunks.text: Prathamesh Kalamkar is based in Dublin, Ireland.

chunks.title: Engineering focus
chunks.text: Prathamesh builds backend services and applied AI systems with an emphasis on grounded outputs, bounded execution, and operational reliability.

chunks.title: Python
chunks.text: Python experience includes typed service design, FastAPI, Pydantic, asynchronous I/O, pytest, and agent tooling.

chunks.title: Java and Spring
chunks.text: Java experience includes Spring Boot services, REST APIs, dependency injection, validation, and automated testing.

chunks.title: Data systems
chunks.text: Data engineering skills include SQL, relational data modelling, SQLite, idempotency, caching, and durable state transitions.

chunks.title: Delivery
chunks.text: Delivery experience includes Docker, Git, GitHub Actions, offline test suites, linting, and continuous integration across supported Python versions.

chunks.title: Research systems
chunks.text: Research tooling experience includes hybrid retrieval, source citations, robots-aware web access, public API integration, and treating fetched content as untrusted data.

chunks.title: MCP server suite
chunks.text: The mcp-servers portfolio project provides five typed Model Context Protocol servers for grounded CV retrieval, repository intelligence, web research, ATS job discovery, and outcome idempotency.

chunks.title: Digital twin
chunks.text: The digital-twin portfolio project demonstrates a recruiter-facing conversational agent with grounded responses and observable tool activity.

chunks.title: Typed failures
chunks.text: Prathamesh designs integration boundaries to return typed failures, enforce per-call deadlines, redact secrets, and avoid leaking low-level exceptions.

chunks.title: Evidence discipline
chunks.text: Claims are separated from evidence: retrieved sources remain untrusted, citations identify exact spans, and unsupported claims are rejected rather than embellished.

chunks.title: Safe public research
chunks.text: Public research components use explicit allow and deny rules, response size and redirect limits, per-host rate limiting, and robots.txt enforcement.
